# `gen.tree`: Tree

Grows a tree from a species preset (broadleaf, conifer, palm, birch, stylized) toward a crown hull, with buttress roots, swept wood and leaf cards, clumps or a crown shell.

- Category: gen
- Version: 1
- Complexity: O(attractors x rounds) for space colonization through a hash grid, plus O(wood faces + cards x pixels)
- Flags: undoable, creates_groups, creates_objects
- Also known as: tree, oak, pine, fir, conifer, palm, birch, foliage, vegetation, speedtree, leaf cards

Trees are described, not drawn. Pick a `species` (its preset sets everything) and change what differs: `height`, `crown` (a shape or an outline), `crown_width`, `fork`, `limbs`, `branch_angle`, `roots`, `foliage`, `card_size`, `coverage`. The trunk and scaffold limbs are laid out from the species; finer branches grow toward the crown hull by seeded space colonization. Branches emerge from their parents on smooth curves, and buttress roots are part of the trunk's surface. Cards are added until the crown silhouette reaches the `coverage` target or the `budget` runs out, oriented by phyllotaxis, spread, droop and sun bias, with seeded atlas variants, flips and turns, per-card tints, a crown gradient, normals blended toward the hull, and wind data (level in vertex color alpha, phase and stiffness in UV layer 1). Material 0 is bark, 1 foliage. Groups: `trunk`, `roots`, `level_1` to `level_3`, `twig_tips`, `foliage`; landmarks `lm.base`, `lm.fork`, `lm.crown_top`, `lm.crown_center`, `lm.crown_base`. The report stays on the object as metadata `vegetation`; `perceive` with aspect `vegetation` measures it.

**Use for** trees, bushes (a short tree with `fork` low) and stylized props. Flowers and grass patches are the `flower` and `grass_cards` features.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `branch_angle` | `Angle \| null` | - | Angle of branches from their parent; scaffold limbs from vertical. |
| `branch_spacing` | `Length \| null` | - | Growth step of the branches (conifer: whorl spacing). |
| `budget` | `number \| null` | - | Triangle budget at LOD0; the wood takes about a third. |
| `card_size` | `Length \| null` | - | Cluster card (or clump) size. |
| `clump_shading` | `ClumpShading \| null` | - | Clumps `faceted` (low poly) or `smooth`. |
| `coverage` | `number \| null` | - | Silhouette coverage target of the crown (0.05 to 1); cards are added until it is reached. |
| `crown` | `TreeCrown \| null` | - | Crown hull: `dome`, `sphere`, `ellipsoid`, `cone`, `umbrella`, `column`, or an outline `[[radius share, height share], ...]` from the crown base up. |
| `crown_base` | `number \| null` | - | Height share of the crown's lowest point; derived from the fork when omitted. |
| `crown_lumps` | `number \| null` | - | Lumps of the crown's outline as a share of its radius (0 smooth to 0.5). |
| `crown_width` | `Length \| null` | - | Crown diameter (broadleaf: about the height). |
| `droop` | `number \| null` | - | Gravity droop of the cards, growing toward the twig tips (0 to 1). |
| `foliage` | `TreeFoliage \| null` | - | What the leaves become: `cards`, `clumps`, `shell` or `none`. |
| `fork` | `number \| null` | - | Height share of the first fork (crown base for conifer and birch, trunk top for palm). |
| `gnarl` | `number \| null` | - | Random bends and curves (0 straight to 1 gnarled). |
| `gradient` | `number \| null` | - | Crown gradient: darker and cooler inside, warmer outside, ambient occlusion (0 to 1). |
| `height` | `Length \| null` | - | Total height (broadleaf 12 m, conifer 15, palm 9, birch 14, stylized 5). |
| `hue_jitter` | `number \| null` | - | Per-card hue variation in vertex color (0 to 1). |
| `leaf_cards` | `number \| null` | - | Share of single-leaf cards at the silhouette. |
| `lean` | `Angle \| null` | - | Lean of the trunk from vertical (0 to 45 degrees). |
| `lean_toward` | `Angle \| null` | - | Heading of the lean: 0 toward +X, 90 toward +Z. |
| `levels` | `number \| null` | - | Branch levels built as wood after the trunk (1 to 3). |
| `limbs` | `number \| null` | - | Scaffold limbs from the fork, branches per whorl (conifer) or fronds (palm). |
| `name` | `string \| null` | - | Object name; `tree` when omitted. |
| `normal_blend` | `number \| null` | - | Crown normal transfer: 0 keeps the card normals, 1 shades like the hull. |
| `parent` | `string \| null` | - | Parent object (name, path or id); top level when omitted. |
| `phyllotaxis` | `Angle \| null` | - | Turn between successive cards around a twig (137.5 degrees). |
| `position` | `[Length, Length, Length]` | `[0.0,0.0,0.0]` | Base position in the parent's space. |
| `root_spread` | `number \| null` | - | Root flare width at the ground over the trunk diameter (1: no flare). |
| `roots` | `number \| null` | - | Buttress roots blended into the trunk base (0 to 12). |
| `seed` | `number \| null` | - | Variation: another seed grows another tree of the same kind. |
| `size_falloff` | `number \| null` | - | Cards get smaller toward the silhouette (0 to 1). |
| `species` | `TreeSpecies \| null` | - | Growth preset: `broadleaf` (default), `conifer`, `palm`, `birch` or `stylized`. |
| `spread` | `Angle \| null` | - | Angle of the cards from their twig. |
| `style` | `TreeStyle \| null` | - | Look: `realistic`, `painted` or `low_poly`; the species' own when omitted. |
| `sun_bias` | `number \| null` | - | Turn of the cards toward the sky (0 to 1). |
| `taper` | `number \| null` | - | Radius ratio of a branch to its parent at an even split (0.3 to 0.98). |
| `trunk_radius` | `Length \| null` | - | Trunk radius at breast height; the species' share of the height when omitted. |
| `twist` | `Angle \| null` | - | Twist of the trunk and scaffold limbs along their length. |
| `value_jitter` | `number \| null` | - | Per-card brightness variation in vertex color (0 to 1). |
| `variants` | `number \| null` | - | Atlas variants the cards pick from (1 to 4). |

## Examples

```json
{"height":"12m","species":"broadleaf"}
```
